name: Local camera intrinsic profiles
method: Per-camera constrained single-plane fits; see each camera record.

0.method: Constrained single-plane fit to 40 frames of floor anchors 101, 102, 104, 105, and 112 in the 1280x960 Continuity Camera stream; EXIF-derived focal length used as the initial guess, principal point fixed, square pixels, zero skew and zero distortion.

1.method: Constrained single-plane fit to 40 frames of the surveyed floor grid; centered principal point, square pixels, zero skew and zero distortion.

2.method: Constrained single-plane fit to 40 frames of the surveyed floor grid; centered principal point, square pixels, zero skew and zero distortion.

validation.note: Replace provisional profiles with multi-pose ChArUco calibrations before metrology-grade 3-D claims. Camera intrinsics remain reusable after a camera is moved only when its physical lens, zoom, resolution, crop, orientation, and stabilization mode are unchanged. Floor tags re-establish extrinsics live. Camera indices are ephemeral; visually re-identify cameras after topology changes.
